# mbse-patterns

> Constraints, queries and (planned) patterns over mbse-schemas data, with mbse-expressions' rules. A constraint is a named Basic rule about one schema's objects, kept as data beside the schemas; validators check data against constraints, three-valued (unknown is not false), and queries select a store's objects by a rule, streaming lazily, through a queryable-store protocol with an in-memory implementation over any store. Equivalent Python (`mbse.Patterns`) and TypeScript (`@mbse/patterns`) implementations write byte-identical JSON.

Patterns (weights over constraints, with distributions of properties and relations), byte-identical pseudorandom generators and streaming characterizers are designed for the next releases.

## Using it

- [Agent skill](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-patterns/blob/main/skills/mbse-patterns/SKILL.md): when to use it, the rules that prevent most mistakes, and references loaded per task
- [Python](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-patterns/blob/main/skills/mbse-patterns/references/python.md) and [TypeScript](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-patterns/blob/main/skills/mbse-patterns/references/typescript.md): a complete program, cheat sheet and traps
